description: Inventory of all sanctioned scripts under .agents/scripts/ with input/output contracts.

scripts.name: curl
scripts.purpose: HTTP client restricted to localhost URLs only (http/https to localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1). Validates all URL arguments and rejects non-localhost targets.
scripts.inputContract: Accepts standard curl arguments. All URL arguments must be absolute http/https URLs targeting localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1. Shell metacharacters (|, ;, &, `, >, <, &&, ||) are forbidden in all arguments.
scripts.outputContract: Passes through curl stdout/stderr. Exits with curl's exit code on failure.

scripts.name: docker
scripts.purpose: Docker CLI wrapper with path and volume mount validation. Ensures all host paths in volume mounts and file references are relative and within the repository root.
scripts.inputContract: First positional argument is the Docker subcommand (e.g., build, run, compose). Remaining arguments are passed to Docker. Path-bearing flags (-f, --file, --env-file) must use relative repo paths. Volume specs (-v, --volume, --mount) must use relative repo paths for bind mounts. Shell metacharacters are forbidden.
scripts.outputContract: Passes through Docker stdout/stderr. Exits with Docker's exit code on failure.

scripts.name: dotnet
scripts.purpose: .NET CLI wrapper restricted to a safe set of actions (test, run, build, restore, format). Validates path-bearing flags and provides built-in output filtering via -MatchPattern and -LastLines parameters.
scripts.inputContract: First positional argument is the action: test, run, build, restore, format, or help. Remaining arguments are forwarded to dotnet CLI. Path-bearing flags (--project, --solution, --startup-project, --results-directory, --output, -o) must use relative repo paths. Optional -MatchPattern <regex> filters output lines. Optional -LastLines <N> returns only the last N lines. Shell metacharacters are forbidden.
scripts.outputContract: Filtered or unfiltered dotnet stdout/stderr. Exits with dotnet's exit code on failure. Help action prints usage examples and exits 0.

scripts.name: git
scripts.purpose: Git CLI wrapper with path validation. Ensures path-bearing flags (-C, --git-dir, --work-tree) reference only relative paths within the repository root.
scripts.inputContract: First positional argument is the Git subcommand (e.g., status, add, commit, log). Remaining arguments are forwarded to git. Path-bearing flags (-C, --git-dir, --work-tree) must use relative repo paths. Shell metacharacters are forbidden.
scripts.outputContract: Passes through git stdout/stderr. Exits with git's exit code on failure.

scripts.name: repo
scripts.purpose: Sandboxed file system operations restricted to the repository root. Provides ls, cat, write, append, mkdir, rm, mv, cp, grep, and touch actions with path traversal protection.
scripts.inputContract: First positional argument is the action: ls, cat, write, append, mkdir, rm, mv, cp, grep, touch, or help. All path arguments must be relative and within the repo root. Write and append require a '--' separator before text content. Shell metacharacters are forbidden. Optional flags: -Recurse, -Depth <N>, -Force depending on action.
scripts.outputContract: Action-dependent: ls outputs file listings; cat outputs file contents; grep outputs matched lines with path:line format; write/append/mkdir/rm/mv/cp/touch produce no output on success. Exits with non-zero code on failure.

sharedModules.name: ScriptSecurity
sharedModules.purpose: Shared PowerShell security module imported by all script implementations. Provides: Fail (error + exit), Assert-NoShellMetachars (block shell injection), Assert-RelativeRepoPath (validate paths are relative and within repo root), Get-RepoRoot (resolve repo root), Assert-PathWithinRoot (validate absolute path containment), Assert-NoReparsePointTraversal (block symlink/junction escapes).
